description: This file defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecordService class, which provides methods to manage employee immigration records in the OrangeHRM system. It handles data access via a DAO, implements CRUD operations, and includes search functionalities.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordService
classes.description: Service layer class for managing employee immigration records, encapsulating data access and business logic.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecordDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the DAO object used for data operations.

methods.name: setEmployeeImmigrationRecordDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO object for the service, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a specific immigration record for an employee by record number.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecordList
methods.description: Fetches all immigration records associated with a specific employee.

methods.name: saveEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Saves a new or existing employee immigration record.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Deletes immigration records specified by their sequence numbers for an employee.

methods.name: searchEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Searches immigration records based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsCount
methods.description: Counts the number of immigration records matching the search filter.
